reader.requirement: At --std 85 the RECORD clause of an SD must carry all of §1985:VII.3.8 (the Sequential I-O RECORD clause): format 1 bounds every record description by integer-1 (SR1); format 2 bounds them by integer-2..integer-3 (SR2), requires integer-3 > integer-2 (SR3) and a DEPENDING ON item that is an elementary unsigned integer in Working-Storage or Linkage (SR4); at run time RELEASE takes its length from data-name-1 or the record (GR10 a-c) and is unsuccessful outside the range (GR10 last paragraph), RELEASE and an unsuccessful RETURN leave data-name-1 alone (GR9), a successful RETURN stores the length (GR11) and RETURN INTO sends that many characters (GR12); format 3 is implementor-defined (GR13-GR15) with no ordering rule on integer-4/integer-5 at this edition.

edition-consulted.switches: each RECORD clause syntax-rule row applies from its Since edition: SR1/SR2/SR3/SR4 rows from 85 (cited through Of1985 as §1985:VII.3.8.3), the format-3 ordering row SR9 only from 2002
the DEPENDING ON section list drops LOCAL-STORAGE below 2002
DialectBehavior.RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize (since 2002): format 3 integer-4/integer-5 bound the record size only from 2002
rangeFailsStatement = DialectLevel < 2002: an out-of-range RELEASE is unsuccessful and releases nothing at 85 (§1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10); from 2002 it raises EC-SORT-MERGE-RELEASE
the BYTES spelling is refused below 2023 (COBOL0900)

reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel, DialectBehavior, Constructs, IsActive in FileControlBinder.FileSection.cs, RecordClauseRules.cs, SortBinder.cs, SortEmitter.cs, CobolSort.cs, VersionConformancePass.cs; the SD arm calls the one BindRecordClause the FD arm calls.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 format 3 'RECORD CONTAINS 5 TO 5' is accepted (no ordering rule) while 2023 refuses it under SR9; an out-of-range RELEASE is unsuccessful at 85 by the binder's own arm; BYTES is refused at 85; LOCAL-STORAGE is absent from the SR4 text.

reader.notes: The SD arm binds its RECORD clause through the one BindRecordClause the FD arm uses and is screened by the one RecordClauseRules table, whose rows carry their 1985 citations and editions; every syntax rule refusal and the run-time GR9-GR12 behaviour probed at --std 85 matched §1985:VII.3.8. GR2's external-connector clause cannot apply to an SD (no EXTERNAL on an SD).
